'''2007 Pennsylvania State Championship Bill Kafer LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Bill Kafer]] at [[2007 Pennsylvania State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Pale Blue Dot
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
